subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sordid
solution:
The solution is **Honourable.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sordid** means involving immoral or dishonourable actions and motives; arousing moral distaste and contempt.

 
 
• Example - I consider this to be a **sordid** story.
 
 
 
• **Honourable** means honest and fair, or deserving praise and respect.
 
 
• Example - He assured her that his intentions were **honourable**.
 
 
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM for 'Sordid' is Honourable.
 
• Therefore **Option 1 **is the correct option.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Censurable** means deserving censure, condemnation, or blame.

 
 
• **Example **- The movie was **censurable**, due to the extreme violence that was unsuitable for minors.
 
 
 
• **Shameful** means worthy of or causing shame or disgrace.
 
 
• **Example** - He **shamefully** turned himself in.
 
 
 
• **Excellent** means extremely good; outstanding.
 
 
• **Example - **The lorry was in **excellent** condition.
